meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面上看不懂的功能提示讲清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果软件界面里冒出提示,你想弄清它到底在说什么。
copy.tagline_en: Explain any in-app feature tip so you know what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a tip pops up in the interface and you want to know what it means.

howto.what: 当你问起某条 senpi 提示时,Claude 会先查实时提示列表和你的设置,再读实际代码核对,然后用你提问的语言给出该提示的深入解释,并列出它读过的文件路径。
howto.when: 当你问某条提示是什么意思、某个被提示的功能怎么运作,或你自己能看到哪些提示时触发。最多列举这三类。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 是什么意思?
say.note: 会先查实时提示列表再解释

say.text: 我这边实际能看到哪些提示?
say.note: 会读你的 settings.json 说明原因

say.text: 这个功能内部是怎么实现的?
say.note: 会读实际代码并给出文件路径

howto.what_en: When you ask about a senpi tip, Claude first queries the live tip list and your settings, then reads the actual code to verify, and explains that exact tip in depth in your language, citing the file paths it read.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask what a tip means, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can personally see in the TUI.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: It looks up the live tip list first.

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see?
say_en.note: It reads your settings.json to answer.

say_en.text: How does that feature work under the hood?
say_en.note: It reads the code and cites file paths.
